verdict.rationale: Synthesia's docs describe creating finished videos with AI avatars and voiceovers from a prompt, and its Video API generates scripted avatar videos. Custom avatars can be made from a single photo and present content without repeated filming, so no camera or studio is needed. A community report confirms Synthesia presenters are used in production, though it calls the presenter 'uncanny'; that is a quality concern, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a stock avatar library, explicit documentation of the paste-a-script workflow in the editor UI (only prompt and API script flows are documented), and independent evidence of presenter realism.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio

citations.quote: Create on-brand videos with AI avatars, voiceovers and motion graphics. Write a prompt and add context. Get a finished video.
Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
Create a personal or branded AI avatar that can present video content without repeated filming.
Create an avatar of yourself from a single photo, for more personal videos.
